schema.null: Not measured, not derivable from retained evidence, or not applicable. Null is never zero.

structure.hw: One field-matched node configuration per accelerator family.
structure.alts: Additional measured node configurations. The gpu field is the full deployed shape.

gpu.meaning: Full deployed shape, for example b300x8

precision.source: run metadata or resolved quantization config

teasbench_commit.meaning: TEASBench commit recorded by the run

tps.meaning: Decode tokens per second per active user

tps_p_basis.meaning: Provenance for tps_p: measured or estimated

decode_throughput_node_tok_s.source: sparsity sidecar output rate, achieved decode batch / TPOT, or batch-one 1 / TPOT

decode_throughput_node_basis.meaning: Provenance for decode_throughput_node_tok_s: sparsity-sidecar, achieved-decode-batch-over-tpot, or single-query-over-tpot

conc.meaning: Legacy alias: decode_batch_achieved on single-turn, task_concurrency_achieved on agentic

rent.meaning: Single-turn rent cost per million decode output tokens

buy.meaning: Single-turn amortised buy cost per million decode output tokens

rentReq.meaning: Rent cost per request or task

buyReq.meaning: Amortised buy cost per request or task

tokReq.meaning: Mean generated tokens per request or task

tokJ.meaning: Decode energy efficiency; agentic values are a task-concurrency proxy
tokJ.source: single-turn: node decode throughput / nameplate power; agentic: per-user decode rate × achieved task concurrency / nameplate power

mfu_p_basis.meaning: Provenance for mfu_p: mixed or estimated

rent_price_basis.meaning: Rule used to select the rent price

rent_selected_offer_count.meaning: Number of offers selected by the pricing rule

normalised_fields.meaning: Tier-scoped 0-100 peer score; higher is better. Cost and latency are inverted. Null means no comparable peer.
